Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] You're probably tracking the wrong number. || Most people track the result, like their weight or how many clients they have. But that number jumps around from day to day, and when it doesn't move, they quit. || [turn] So track the input instead. The thing you actually do, and fully control. || Trying to lose weight? Track three gym sessions this week, and dinner cooked at home five nights. || Growing a freelance business? You can't make a client say yes. But you can send five proposals a week, and follow up on every single one. || [land] Hit your inputs for a few weeks, and the result usually follows. And on the days it doesn't, you still know you did your part. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
